text_en: Six days before the Passover Jesus came to Bethany, the home of Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.
text_cn: 逾越节前六天，耶稣来到伯达尼，就是耶稣从死者中唤起拉匝禄的地方。

text_en: There they gave a dinner for him. Martha served, and Lazarus was one of those at the table with him.
text_cn: 有人在那里为他摆设了晚宴，玛尔大伺候，而拉匝禄也是和耶稣一起坐席的一位。

text_en: Mary took a pound of costly perfume made of pure nard, anointed Jesus’ feet, and wiped them with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
text_cn: 那时，玛利亚拿了一斤极珍贵的纯‘拿尔多’香液，敷抹了耶稣的脚，并用自己的头发擦干，屋里便充满了香液的气味。

text_en: But Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples (the one who was about to betray him), said,
text_cn: 那要负卖耶稣的依斯加略犹达斯──即他的一个门徒──便说：

text_en: “Why was this perfume not sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor? ”
text_cn: “为什么不把这香液去卖三百块‘德纳’，施舍给穷人呢？”

text_en: (He said this not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief; he kept the common purse and used to steal what was put into it. )
text_cn: 他说这话，并不是因为他关心穷人，只因为他是个贼，掌管钱囊，常偷取其中所存放的。

text_en: Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She bought it so that she might keep it for the day of my burial.
text_cn: 耶稣就说：“由她罢！这原是她为我安葬之日而保存的。

text_en: You always have the poor with you, but you do not always have me. ”
text_cn: 你们常有穷人和你们在一起；至于我，你们却不常有。”

text_en: When the great crowd of the Jews learned that he was there, they came not only because of Jesus but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.
text_cn: 有许多犹太人听说耶稣在那里，就来了，不但是为耶稣，也是为看他从死者中所唤起的拉匝禄。

text_en: So the chief priests planned to put Lazarus to death as well,
text_cn: 为此，司祭长议决连拉匝禄也要杀掉，

text_en: since it was on account of him that many of the Jews were deserting and were believing in Jesus.
text_cn: 因为有许多犹太人为了拉匝禄的缘故，离开他们，而信从了耶稣。

text_en: The next day the great crowd that had come to the festival heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 第二天，来过节的群众，听说耶稣来到耶路撒冷，

text_en: So they took branches of palm trees and went out to meet him, shouting, “Hosanna! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord— the King of Israel! ”
text_cn: 便拿了棕榈枝，出去迎接他，喊说：“贺三纳！因上主之名而来的，以色列的君王，应受赞颂。”

text_en: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it; as it is written:
text_cn: 耶稣找了一匹小驴，就骑上去，正如经上所记载的：

text_en: “Do not be afraid, daughter of Zion. Look, your king is coming, sitting on a donkey’s colt! ”
text_cn: “熙雍女子，不要害怕！看，你的君王骑着驴驹来了！”

text_en: His disciples did not understand these things at first; but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things had been written of him and had been done to him.
text_cn: 起初他的门徒也没有明白这些事，然而，当耶稣受光荣以后，他们才想起这些话是指着他而记载的。为此，他们就这样对他做了。

text_en: So the crowd that had been with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to testify.
text_cn: 当耶稣叫拉匝禄从坟墓中出来，由死者中唤起他时，那时同他在一起的众人，都为所见的作证；

text_en: It was also because they heard that he had performed this sign that the crowd went to meet him.
text_cn: 因此，有一群人去迎接他，因为他们听说他行了这个神迹；

text_en: The Pharisees then said to one another, “You see, you can do nothing. Look, the world has gone after him! ”
text_cn: 于是法利塞人便彼此说：“看，你们一无所成！瞧，全世界都跟他去了。”

text_en: Now among those who went up to worship at the festival were some Greeks.
text_cn: 在那些上来过节，崇拜天主的人中，有些希腊人。

text_en: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and said to him, “Sir, we wish to see Jesus. ”
text_cn: 他们来到加里肋亚贝特赛达人斐理伯前，请求他说：“先生！我们愿拜见耶稣。”

text_en: Philip went and told Andrew; then Andrew and Philip went and told Jesus.
text_cn: 斐理伯就去告诉安德肋，然后安德肋和斐理伯便来告诉耶稣。

text_en: Jesus answered them, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
text_cn: 耶稣开口向他们说：“人子要受光荣的时辰到了。

text_en: Very truly, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just a single grain; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.
text_cn: 我实实在在告诉你们：一粒麦子如果不落在地里死了，仍只是一粒；如果死了，才结出许多子粒来。

text_en: Those who love their life lose it, and those who hate their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
text_cn: 爱惜自己性命的，必要丧失性命；在现世憎恨自己性命的，必要保存性命入于永生。

text_en: Whoever serves me must follow me, and where I am, there will my servant be also. Whoever serves me, the Father will honor.
text_cn: 谁若事奉我，就当跟随我；如此，我在哪里，我的仆人也要在哪里；谁若事奉我，我父必要尊重他。

text_en: “Now my soul is troubled. And what should I say—‘Father, save me from this hour’? No, it is for this reason that I have come to this hour.
text_cn: 现在我心神烦乱，我可说什么呢？我说：父啊！救我脱离这时辰罢？但正是为此，我才到了这时辰。

text_en: Father, glorify your name. ” Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again. ”
text_cn: 父啊！光荣你的名罢！”当时有声音来自天上：“我已光荣了我的名，我还要光荣。”

text_en: The crowd standing there heard it and said that it was thunder. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him. ”
text_cn: 在场听见的群众，便说：“这是打雷。”另有人说：“是天使同他说话。”

text_en: Jesus answered, “This voice has come for your sake, not for mine.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“这声音不是为我而来，而是为你们。

text_en: Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be driven out.
text_cn: 现在就是这世界应受审判的时候，现在这世界的元首就要被赶出去；

text_en: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself. ”
text_cn: 至于我，当我从地上被举起来时，便要吸引众人来归向我。”

text_en: He said this to indicate the kind of death he was to die.
text_cn: 他说这话，是表明他要以怎样的死而死。

text_en: The crowd answered him, “We have heard from the law that the Messiah remains forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man? ”
text_cn: 于是群众回答他说：“我们从《法律》上知道：默西亚要存留到永远；你怎么说：人子必须被举起呢？这个人子是谁？”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “The light is with you for a little longer. Walk while you have the light, so that the darkness may not overtake you. If you walk in the darkness, you do not know where you are going.
text_cn: 耶稣遂给他们说：“光在你们中间还有片刻。你们趁着还有光的时候，应该行走，免得黑暗笼罩了你们。那在黑暗中行走的，不知道往哪里去。

text_en: While you have the light, believe in the light, so that you may become children of light. ” After Jesus had said this, he departed and hid from them.
text_cn: 几时你们还有光，应当信从光，好成为光明之子。”耶稣讲完了这些话，就躲开他们，隐藏去了。

text_en: Although he had performed so many signs in their presence, they did not believe in him.
text_cn: 耶稣虽然在他们面前行了这么多的神迹，他们仍然不信他；

text_en: This was to fulfill the word spoken by the prophet Isaiah: “Lord, who has believed our message, and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed? ”
text_cn: 这正应验了依撒意亚先知所说的话：“上主！有谁会相信我们的报道呢？上主的手臂又向谁显示了出来呢？”

text_en: And so they could not believe, because Isaiah also said,
text_cn: 他们不能信，因为依撒意亚又说过：

text_en: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, so that they might not look with their eyes, and understand with their heart and turn— and I would heal them. ”
text_cn: “上主使他们瞎了眼，使他们硬了心，免得他们眼睛看见，心里觉悟而悔改，使我治好他们。”

text_en: Isaiah said this because he saw his glory and spoke about him.
text_cn: 依撒意亚因为看见了他的光荣，所以指着他讲了这话。

text_en: Nevertheless many, even of the authorities, believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they did not confess it, for fear that they would be put out of the synagogue;
text_cn: 事虽如此，但在首领中，仍有许多人信从了耶稣，只为了法利塞人而不敢明认，免得被逐出会堂，

text_en: for they loved human glory more than the glory that comes from God.
text_cn: 因为他们喜爱世人的光荣，胜过天主的光荣。

text_en: Then Jesus cried aloud: “Whoever believes in me believes not in me but in him who sent me.
text_cn: 耶稣呼喊说：“信我的，不是信我，而是信那派遣我来的；

text_en: And whoever sees me sees him who sent me.
text_cn: 看见我的，也就是看见那派遣我来的。

text_en: I have come as light into the world, so that everyone who believes in me should not remain in the darkness.
text_cn: 我身为光明，来到了世界上，使凡信我的，不留在黑暗中。

text_en: I do not judge anyone who hears my words and does not keep them, for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
text_cn: 无论谁，若听我的话而不遵行，我不审判他，因为我不是为审判世界而来，乃是为拯救世界。

text_en: The one who rejects me and does not receive my word has a judge; on the last day the word that I have spoken will serve as judge,
text_cn: 拒绝我，及不接受我话的，自有审判他的：就是我所说的话，要在末日审判他。

text_en: for I have not spoken on my own, but the Father who sent me has himself given me a commandment about what to say and what to speak.
text_cn: 因为我没有凭我自己说话，而是派遣我来的父，他给我出了命，叫我该说什么，该讲什么。

text_en: And I know that his commandment is eternal life. What I speak, therefore, I speak just as the Father has told me. ”
text_cn: 我知道他的命令就是永生；所以，我所讲论的，全是依照父对我所说的而讲论的。”
